# help showsharesetting
showsharesetting - Display information of all sharesettings or a specific sharesetting in a filesystem.

SYNTAX
    showsharesetting [sharesetting_name]

DESCRIPTION
    The showsharesetting command displays information about all the sharesettings
    or a specific sharesetting in a filesystem.

AUTHORITY
    Any role in the system

OPTIONS
    -allnames
        Shows both the shortened and full sharesetting names.

SPECIFIERS
    <sharesetting_name>
        Specifies the sharesetting name whose information will be displayed.
        If not specified, information of all sharesettings
        in the system is displayed.

NOTES
    Long names can cause the display to be very wide. Use -shortnames
    to display shortened 31 character names for objects. Use the setclienv
    command to set shortnames to 1. The -shortnames option is also set to 1
    if the CLI was started with the -shortnames option, or if the CLI was
    started with the TPDSHORTNAMES environment variable set. Run "cli -h"
    and "setclienv -h" for details of the environment variables.

EXAMPLES
    The following example displays all the sharesettings on the system.

       cli% showsharesetting

    The following example displays settings1 sharesetting specifically.

       cli% showsharesetting settings1
